scientific_integrity: The forward area identity is explicitly credited. Only its full-spectrum reverse reconstruction and exact phase-fiber interpretation are presented as candidate new content; numerical checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Full continuous isoptic-area function and C2 strictly positively curved boundary required; does not recover Fourier phases, translation, or noise-stable finite-data inversion; the published 2003 forward Fourier area identity is prior work; independent historical priority unknown.
title: Exact spectral recovery from the areas of all isoptics of a smooth convex oval
